root_cause: The runner lost network connectivity to azure.archive.ubuntu.com during apt-get update in the Debian Packages job. The host 52.250.76.244 was unreachable after multiple retries spanning ~4 minutes, indicating a transient Azure network outage or runner infrastructure issue. This is unrelated to the PR change (which only modifies src/plugins/intel_npu/tests/driver_version.json).
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure on Azure runner infrastructure
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Debian Packages job or re-add the PR to the merge queue
If the failure persists, investigate Azure networking issues in the runner region
prevention_strategies: Add apt-get retry logic or fallback mirrors for Ubuntu package repositories in Debian packaging CI jobs.
historical_context: No prior identical pattern found in the database. Network-related apt-get failures have been seen before (e.g., RISCV64 Docker build libpython3-dev, though that was a dependency issue).
